review:
A 25-line book slot with a money respin bolted on. The book does its usual job, while a silver coin opens a second route to wins.

When the coin lands, it either pays the Mega Jackpot – up to 1,000x your bet – or starts a Money Respin, where every money symbol's value adds up. The jackpot side gives it more variety than a pure book game. 96.69% RTP, one of Pragmatic's higher ones.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
